exportPack.checklist.title: Export Pack Checklist — {channelName}
exportPack.checklist.intro: Follow these steps to upload "{listingTitle}" to {channelName} manually. This pack was generated by OmniSell because {channelName} has no public upload API — automating it would violate their Terms of Service.
exportPack.checklist.step1: 1. Sign in to {channelName} and open its upload/create page.
exportPack.checklist.step2: 2. Upload every file inside the print-files/ folder of this pack.
exportPack.checklist.step3: 3. Open field-cards.html in a browser, then copy each field into the matching field on the channel.
exportPack.checklist.step4: 4. Set the price for each variant using metadata.csv as your reference.
exportPack.checklist.step5: 5. Check the mockups/ folder to confirm how the design will look, then continue.
exportPack.checklist.step6: 6. Once the listing is live on {channelName}, return to OmniSell → Channels → Export Packs and mark this pack as confirmed so listing status and analytics stay in sync.
exportPack.checklist.tagLimitNote: Note: {channelName} allows at most {maxTags} tags per listing. field-cards.html already trims the tag list to fit.
exportPack.fieldCards.copyHint: Click inside a box, select all, and copy.
